## Command type

The concrete records and typed nil pointers accepted by upstream syntax.Command. Typed nil kinds are limited to this interface's actual implementers; auxiliary records are excluded.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Command =
  | ArithmCmd
  | BinaryCmd
  | Block
  | CallExpr
  | CaseClause
  | CoprocClause
  | DeclClause
  | ForClause
  | FuncDecl
  | IfClause
  | LetClause
  | Subshell
  | TestClause
  | TestDecl
  | TimeClause
  | WhileClause
  | TypedNil<
      | 'ArithmCmd'
      | 'BinaryCmd'
      | 'Block'
      | 'CallExpr'
      | 'CaseClause'
      | 'CoprocClause'
      | 'DeclClause'
      | 'ForClause'
      | 'FuncDecl'
      | 'IfClause'
      | 'LetClause'
      | 'Subshell'
      | 'TestClause'
      | 'TestDecl'
      | 'TimeClause'
      | 'WhileClause'
    >;
```
